history.title: The history of India is rich and diverse...

data.back: One of the earliest civilizations in India, flourished around 2500 BCE in cities like Harappa and Mohenjo-daro.
One of the largest empires in ancient India, founded by Chandragupta Maurya, with Ashoka spreading Buddhism after the Kalinga War.
Founded by Babur in 1526, played a significant role in shaping Indian culture and architecture, with notable rulers like Akbar and Shah Jahan.
Also known as the First War of Independence, one of the earliest major uprisings against British rule in India.
Gained on August 15, 1947, with Jawaharlal Nehru becoming the first Prime Minister of independent India, after a long freedom struggle led by Mahatma Gandhi and others.

history.title: The history of India is rich and diverse...

data.back: One of the earliest civilizations in India, flourished around 2500 BCE in cities like Harappa and Mohenjo-daro.
One of the largest empires in ancient India, founded by Chandragupta Maurya.
Remembered for spreading Buddhism after the Kalinga War, grandson of Chandragupta Maurya.
Played a significant role in shaping Indian culture and architecture, founded by Babur in 1526.
Founded the Mughal Empire in 1526 after winning the First Battle of Panipat.
Built by Shah Jahan in memory of his wife, a famous monument in India.
Also known as the First War of Independence, one of the earliest major uprisings against British rule.
Promoted non-violence and civil disobedience in India's freedom struggle.
Advocated a more aggressive approach and led the Indian National Army during the freedom struggle.
Gained independence from British rule on August 15, 1947, with Jawaharlal Nehru as the first Prime Minister.
